response.original_title: Suchmos The Blow Your Mind TOUR 2026 Behind the Scenes
response.overview: Suchmos held their "The Blow Your Mind TOUR 2026" in nine cities across Japan from May to July this year. This tour was a joint-show format featuring artists that Suchmos respects, and was originally scheduled for 2020 but was canceled due to the global pandemic. Following Suchmos' return to activity last year, this tour marks their first comeback in approximately six years, with a total of nine guest acts: IO, GLIM SPANKY, Quruli, Ryosuke Nagaoka, cero, Hanaregumi, GRAPEVINE, The Birthday, and Fujii Kaze. The stage featured a diverse array of guest artists, reflecting Suchmos' roots in a wide range of musical styles.
